title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 41
description: Ten questions on Psalms 41: blessing for the one who considers the poor, betrayal by a close friend, and Yahweh who upholds.

questions.text: Who is called blessed in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "Blessed is he who considers the poor."

questions.text: Where will Yahweh sustain the one who considers the poor, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed and restore him from his bed of illness.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you."

answers.text: To give him long life and riches
To heal him, for he has sinned
To make him king over all Israel
To punish his false friend now

questions.text: What do the psalmist's enemies say about him in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says his enemies speak evil against him: "When will he die, and his name perish?"

answers.text: "When will he die, and his name perish?"

questions.text: What do all who hate the psalmist do together in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says all who hate him whisper together against him.

answers.text: They pray for him in secret
They sing songs in his honor
They bring him food and water

questions.text: What do they say has afflicted the psalmist, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says they say, "An evil disease has afflicted him."

questions.text: What did the psalmist's own familiar friend, who ate bread with him, do?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says his familiar friend, in whom he trusted and who ate bread with him, has lifted up his heel against him.

answers.text: He paid all of his debts
He defended him before the judges
He wept with him at his bed
He lifted up his heel against him

questions.text: By what does the psalmist know that Yahweh delights in him?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says, "By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn't triumph over me."

answers.text: He has become very rich indeed
He has many sons and daughters
His enemy doesn't triumph over him
He lives in a royal palace

questions.text: In what does Yahweh uphold the psalmist, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, "As for me, you uphold me in my integrity."

questions.text: How does the last verse of the psalm end?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 ends, "Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen."
